extensions.name: Particles Tools
extensions.description: RQL module for Godot GPU particles (2D & 3D): validated emitter settings and Restart() for the core rql-query / rql-mutate tools, plus an agent guide.

extensions.name: Tilemap Tools
extensions.description: RQL module for Godot TileMapLayer (4.3+): used-cell rows and SetCell / EraseCell / Clear for the core rql-query / rql-mutate tools, plus an agent guide.

extensions.name: Navigation Tools
extensions.description: RQL module for Godot navigation (2D & 3D): validated agent, region and link settings, region Bake() and polygon outlines for the core rql-query / rql-mutate tools, plus an agent guide.

extensions.name: Animation Tools
extensions.description: RQL module for Godot AnimationPlayer: libraries, animations, tracks and keys for the core rql-query / rql-mutate tools, plus an agent guide.

extensions.name: CSG Tools
extensions.description: RQL module for Godot CSG (constructive solid geometry): validated box / sphere / cylinder / torus dimensions and rootShape for the core rql-query / rql-mutate tools, plus an agent guide.

extensions.name: GridMap Tools
extensions.description: RQL module for Godot GridMap (3D tile maps): validated settings, cell rows and SetCell / ClearCell / Clear for the core rql-query / rql-mutate tools, plus an agent guide.

extensions.name: PhantomCamera Tools
extensions.description: RQL module for the Godot Phantom Camera addon: a phantomcamera source that lists virtual cameras and hosts with their modes by name, and validated SetFollow / SetLookAt calls.

extensions.name: Beehave Tools
extensions.description: RQL module for the Godot Beehave addon (behaviour trees): a beehave source that lists trees and their nodes with their Beehave classes; build trees with the core AddChild.

extensions.name: Dialogic Tools
extensions.description: RQL module for the Godot Dialogic addon: a dialogic source that lists timelines and characters, creates them and appends timeline text.

extensions.name: Terrain3D Tools
extensions.description: RQL module for the Terrain3D addon (TokisanGames heightmap terrain): terrain3d source with validated ChangeRegionSize, addon check and material creation for the core rql-query / rql-mutate tools, plus an agent guide.
